name: se-org
description: An open-source engineering-role catalogue with 191 active role definitions and a local project-memory CLI.

scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run validate && bun test && bun run memory:doctor
scripts.gen: bun run src/cli.ts roles --markdown > se/agents/role-inventory.md && bun run src/cli.ts ownership --markdown > se/agents/ownership-matrix.md
scripts.bench: bun run scripts/bench/routing.ts && bun run scripts/bench/paraphrase.ts
